name: American Coastal Insurance Corp
summary:
American Coastal Insurance (ACIC) reported earnings of $0.39 per share on revenue of $71.22 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.44 per share on revenue of $75.78 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 11.36% while revenue fell 1.35% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

American Coastal Insurance Corporation is the holding company of the insurance carrier, American Coastal Insurance Company, which was founded in 2007 for the purpose of insuring Condominium and Homeowner Association properties, and apartments in the state of Florida.
subject: American Coastal Insurance Missed Consensus Estimates
